sections.title: Use of Proceeds
sections.excerpt:
Use of proceeds The net proceeds of this offering, after deducting the commissions
payable to the Placement Agent and our estimated offering expenses, will be used for general corporate purposes, which may include, among
other things, funding for working capital needs, debt repayments, construction of our newbuilding vessels, the payment of the outstanding
balance of the purchase price payable to our Former Parent for the acquisition of Roman Shark V Inc. and the acquisition of additional
secondhand or newbuilding vessels in accordance with our business strategy. However, we have not identified any potential acquisitions,
and we can provide no assurance that we will be able to complete the acquisition of any additional vessels that we are able to identify.
